reason: B is the more feasible proposal because it tests the thermodynamic–kinetic competition in an experimentally accessible 800–1100 °C window and explicitly treats application to the Cr-rich composition as an extrapolation. A predicts an ordering onset near 1600 °C, likely above or too close to the alloy’s melting regime, making its central comparison physically questionable, although both proposals insufficiently distinguish B2 ordering from the low-Al clustering instability reported previously.
